notes.title: Kickstarter: One Week Left! Support Hawthorn Today!
notes.content:
Hawthorn’s Kickstarter has come a long way in three short weeks! We’ve not only reached our initial funding goal, but have also unlocked three more goals! With your support, we will now be adding:
[list]
[*] Tameable Hummingbird pets
[*] Foundational gameplay for Spring, Summer, Winter, and Fall
[*] A main story chapter: “Hawthorn House”
[/list]
We’re overwhelmed by the momentum so far, but the journey is not over yet! There is one week left to the current campaign! We warmly invite all our followers to continue sharing the Kickstarter with your friends, family, and fellow adventurers. There’s still time to make Hawthorn even bigger, including our upcoming “mystery” gameplay goal, and after that, our much-anticipated housing and building system!

Meanwhile, our little team is hard at work preparing some exciting announcements we hope to share in the coming week. Stay tuned!

In other exciting news, Hawthorn is officially taking part in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CozyFamilyFriendlyGamesCelebration2025]Steam’s Cozy & Family Friendly Games Celebration 2025[/url] as an Upcoming Game! This event starts on Steam today and runs through June 2nd, showcasing a lot of great games and discounts.

Once again, our most heartfelt thanks go out to every one of you who has backed this journey and helped to bring the world of Hawthorn to life!
